metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal cosine of sampled catalog embeddings, mapped by (cosine+1)/2. PAD and MASK are excluded. Higher values indicate directional similarity; 0.5 corresponds to mean cosine zero. This does not measure recommendation diversity. Null means fewer than two sampled catalog embeddings.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit at supervised MASK positions with valid, distinct catalog positive/negative IDs. Uses one training diagnostic negative per position; does not estimate host 100-candidate HR@10. Null means no measured positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile of measured masked-position margins. Null means no measured positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of measured masked positions with margin < 0. Null means no measured positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of measured masked positions with margin < eps=0.5. This threshold depends on score scale. Null means no measured positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Reports measured supervised-mask count, margin threshold and low/wrong-margin counts. Category annotations are unavailable; empty category lists are not measured zero counts. Reviews, ownership and simulator traits are unobserved.
